question: Squirrel cage induction motor is __________ phase induction motor.
solution:
The correct answer is __a three**(phase induction motor)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A squirrel cage induction motor__ is a type of three-phase induction motor.
 
• The rotor of this motor is shaped like a squirrel cage for its simple design and durability.
 
• It is widely used in various industrial applications due to its reliability and low maintenance.
 
• This motor operates on three-phase AC power and is highly efficient.
 
• It is a self-starting motor, eliminating the need for additional starting mechanisms.
 
• The absence of brushes and slip rings makes it robust and less prone to mechanical wear.
 
• Squirrel cage induction motors are extensively used in pumps, fans, conveyors, and compressors.
 
• These motors are known for their low cost and high efficiency.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Single-phase Induction Motor:**
 
 
• These motors operate on single-phase AC power and are generally used for small applications.
 
• They require additional starting mechanisms, such as capacitors or auxiliary windings.
 
 
 
• **Two-phase Induction Motor:**
 
 
• These motors are used in specific applications and require two-phase power for operation.
 
• They are less common than single-phase or three-phase motors.
 
 
 
• **Three-phase Induction Motor:**
 
 
• Widely used in industrial setups due to their efficiency and robustness.
 
• They do not require any additional starting mechanisms.
